# ADO302: invalid-function

An unknown function is called, or a function has the wrong number of arguments.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Category** | Expressions |
| **Default severity** | error |
| **Enabled by default** | yes |
| **Checked on** | each original source file, before template expansion |

## Description

Only the documented expression functions and job status check functions are available. Each function has a minimum and maximum number of arguments.

### Known functions

| Function | Arguments |
| --- | --- |
| `always` (job status check) | exactly 0 argument(s) |
| `and` | at least 2 argument(s) |
| `canceled` (job status check) | exactly 0 argument(s) |
| `coalesce` | at least 2 argument(s) |
| `contains` | exactly 2 argument(s) |
| `containsValue` | exactly 2 argument(s) |
| `convertToJson` | exactly 1 argument(s) |
| `counter` | exactly 2 argument(s) |
| `endsWith` | exactly 2 argument(s) |
| `eq` | exactly 2 argument(s) |
| `failed` (job status check) | at least 0 argument(s) |
| `format` | at least 1 argument(s) |
| `ge` | exactly 2 argument(s) |
| `gt` | exactly 2 argument(s) |
| `iif` | 1 to 3 arguments |
| `in` | at least 1 argument(s) |
| `join` | exactly 2 argument(s) |
| `le` | exactly 2 argument(s) |
| `length` | exactly 1 argument(s) |
| `lower` | exactly 1 argument(s) |
| `lt` | exactly 2 argument(s) |
| `ne` | exactly 2 argument(s) |
| `not` | exactly 1 argument(s) |
| `notIn` | at least 1 argument(s) |
| `or` | at least 2 argument(s) |
| `replace` | exactly 3 argument(s) |
| `split` | exactly 2 argument(s) |
| `startsWith` | exactly 2 argument(s) |
| `succeeded` (job status check) | at least 0 argument(s) |
| `succeededOrFailed` (job status check) | at least 0 argument(s) |
| `trim` | exactly 1 argument(s) |
| `upper` | exactly 1 argument(s) |
| `xor` | exactly 2 argument(s) |

## Example

Problem:

```yaml
condition: eq(variables.a)
```

Instead:

```yaml
condition: eq(variables.a, 'b')
```

## Configuration

Change the severity or turn the rule off in `.adolint.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  ADO302: off   # off | info | warning | error
```

Or on the command line: `adolint lint --disable ADO302` or `--enable ADO302`.

Suppress a single finding with a comment on the line before it (or `disable-line` at the end of the line):

```yaml
# adolint:disable-next-line ADO302
```
